edge_lift.proof: At N-2d=0 no straight edge transition occurs. The complete terminal transfer is the identity join between consecutive corner endpoints.

minimum_test.proof: Every four-cycle of total cost at most K has an arc of cost at most floor(K/4). No such arc exists.

zero_length_transfer.proof: A path of length zero exists exactly when its source state equals the corner incoming state, and then has cost zero.

terminal_identity_certificate.proof: A zero-length path has charge zero and exists exactly when the preceding output state equals the next corner's incoming state. No compatible mapping means the terminal directed side transfer has no arc, hence no four-cycle.
